rules.title: Respect module boundaries
rules.text: Respect module boundaries; depend on public interfaces, not internals of other modules.

rules.title: Small focused functions
rules.text: Keep functions small and single-purpose; extract when a function mixes levels of abstraction.

rules.title: Avoid premature abstraction
rules.text: Prefer a little duplication over a premature abstraction; abstract after the third repetition.

rules.title: Separate pure logic from I/O
rules.text: Keep business logic pure and push I/O to the edges so it is easy to test.

rules.title: Prefer immutability
rules.text: Prefer immutable data and avoid mutating function arguments.

rules.title: Remove dead code
rules.text: Delete unused code and commented-out code instead of leaving it behind.

rules.title: Record decisions
rules.text: Record significant architectural decisions in docs/adr before implementing them.
